source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR,FULLDATE) FULLDATE FROM EDS.DATE_DIM EDD
WHERE EDD.MONTH_END = 'Y' AND EDD.YEAR IN (2024,2025) AND FULLDATE <='2025-04-30' ORDER BY 1
